limitations: L4 is offline synthetic fixture acceptance only; no method, detector, product or physical validity is established.
The six-injection fixture contains five standards plus one blank; zero variance refuses and fewer than the frozen minimum standards gives unavailable RSDs.
Hashes cannot establish historical freeze timing or true source independence. Independent review remains unavailable.

Conservative case-insensitive English whole-word/prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Also truth, physical validity, patient benefit, method valid* (including method is valid*), product quality, system qualif* and release. The gate includes negations and is incomplete.
Unavailable evidence requires unavailable claims. Computed agreement and review approval never support positive claims; one synthetic fixture cannot establish replication.
Read-only inputs are bounded to 64 MiB each, 256 MiB aggregate and 4000000 JSON values; hardlink aliases share initial reads and parsing.
